limits: One model, one input, one supervised session; these are descriptive saved samples, not a general overhead estimate.
The complete GPU screen is contaminated under the frozen rule; desktop or external GPU load may affect the samples.
CPU busy fraction is an aggregate controller-lifetime bracket including this process; >64 logical processors can be limited to the caller processor group.
The suite point and separate subject-observer interval establish host-work overlap at controller scope, not per-sample load or causal attribution.
Wall includes host trace and validation; GPU events cover a different stream interval. Parent polling and fsync can overlap.
Reset PyTorch peaks are process-local for the recorded windows; CUDA and NVIDIA-SMI free values are separate device-wide point samples and do not establish a full-run peak or future bound.
The source-defined successful parent path checks same-owner zero-exit supervision and Job quiescence, but no independent Job lifetime-count record was saved.
The reported success and cleanup are cooperative saved records; the later unlocked OS point and zero allocator counters do not prove native CUDA teardown or global isolation.
